name: un-brokers
description: Insurance brokerage website with quotation inquiries and an admin dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:memory -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
